plain: A follower who learns from a teacher.

webster.text: A learner; a scholar; one who receives or professes to receive instruction from another; as the disciples of Plato.

example.quote: I shall be a stanch and faithful disciple of his.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
